evidence: Modifies src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to acquire cs_main in blockheaderToJSON and getchaintxstats.
rationale: The change fixes a data race where getblockheader and getchaintxstats read CBlockIndex fields without holding cs_main. While acquiring cs_main fixes undefined behavior reproduced under TSan, it introduces minor lock contention and addresses an edge-case concurrency issue in RPC endpoints.
